title: Southwest Black Bean & Corn Bowls
seoTitle: Southwest Black Bean & Corn Bowls | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: A cold, meal-prep-friendly bowl of black beans, corn, quinoa, and avocado with lime dressing
subtitle: A cold, meal-prep-friendly bowl of black beans, corn, quinoa, and avocado with lime dressing
description: Quinoa, black beans, roasted corn, bell pepper, and avocado come together with a lime-cumin dressing. It is served cold or at room temperature and is built specifically to pack well for several days.

steps.title: Cook the quinoa
steps.instruction: Rinse quinoa well, then simmer with water in a lidded pot 15 minutes until tender and the liquid is absorbed. Fluff and spread on a sheet pan to cool quickly so it doesn't turn mushy in the dressing.

steps.title: Char the corn
steps.instruction: Toast corn in a dry, wide skillet over medium-high 4–5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until several kernels brown. Set aside to cool.

steps.title: Dice the vegetables
steps.instruction: Dice bell pepper and red onion into a small, even size so they distribute evenly through the grain base.

steps.title: Mix the lime-cumin dressing
steps.instruction: Whisk lime juice, olive oil, cumin, chili powder, and a pinch of salt until combined.

steps.title: Combine and dress the base
steps.instruction: Toss cooled quinoa with black beans, charred corn, bell pepper, and red onion. Pour dressing over and toss well to coat everything evenly.

steps.title: Add avocado and cilantro at the end
steps.instruction: Fold in diced avocado and cilantro right before serving, or hold them separately if packing ahead so the avocado doesn't brown or turn mushy.

proTips: Prep tip: Cool quinoa fully before dressing it, or the heat will wilt the vegetables and dull the lime flavor.
Rookie tip: Pack avocado in its own small container for multi-day meal prep and add it fresh each time.
Add grilled chicken or shrimp on top for crews who want more protein than the beans and quinoa provide alone.
A squeeze of extra lime right before eating brightens up bowls that have been in the fridge a couple of days.
tonightSpread: Main: Southwest black bean and corn bowls
Sides: Tortilla chips, extra lime wedges
Set hot components closest to the crew; cold crunch and toppings at the far end of the line.
Keep a backup tray at 200°F for firefighters returning from a run.
leftovers: Keeps well covered and cold for up to 5 days without the avocado.
Add avocado fresh to each portion rather than mixing it into the full batch ahead of time.
Serve leftovers over greens or wrapped in a tortilla for variety.
whyCrewsLikeIt: No stove time is needed at the point of service, it travels well in individual containers, and it gives the crew a genuine vegetarian option that still reads as a full meal.
mealPrepNotes: Make-ahead: this bowl is designed entirely for advance prep. Storage: keep quinoa, beans, corn, and pepper together up to 5 days; add avocado and dressing just before eating. Reheating: none required — serve cold or room temperature.
substitutions: Use brown rice instead of quinoa.
Use pinto beans instead of black beans.
Add crumbled feta or cotija for extra flavor and protein.
